mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.template_no AS "templateNo", t.name, t.island_id AS "islandId", t.status, t.spec, (SELECT count(*) FROM experiment_template_process p WHERE p.template_id = t.id AND p.tenant_id = t.tenant_id) AS "processCount", (SELECT count(*) FROM manifest_item m WHERE m.template_id = t.id AND m.tenant_id = t.tenant_id) AS "manifestCount" FROM experiment_template t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{t} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.island_id = #{islandId} AND t.status = #{status} ORDER BY t.id

SELECT id, template_no AS "templateNo", name, island_id AS "islandId", status, spec, point_whitelist AS "pointWhitelist" FROM experiment_template WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO experiment_template (tenant_id, template_no, name, island_id, workflow_ids, spec) VALUES (#{t}, #{templateNo}, #{name}, #{islandId}, CAST(#{workflowIds} AS bigint[]), #{spec}::jsonb)
mapper.update:
UPDATE experiment_template
name = #{name}, status = #{status}, spec = #{spec}::jsonb, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT code FROM resource_node WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id FROM workflow WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND code = #{code} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM resource_node WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND kind = 'island' AND code = #{code} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT dm.id FROM device_instance di JOIN device_method dm ON dm.device_model_id = di.device_model_id AND dm.scope = 'model' JOIN resource_node rn ON rn.id = di.resource_id WHERE dm.tenant_id = #{t} AND rn.code = #{deviceCode} AND dm.method = #{methodName} ORDER BY dm.id LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM material_role WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND role_code = #{roleCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT wn.node_key AS "nodeKey", nb.seq AS "seq", dev.code AS "deviceCode", rn.code AS "pointCode", dm.method AS "methodName", nb.material_role AS "materialRole", nb.loading_pattern AS "loadingPattern", nb.barcode_policy AS "barcodePolicy", nb.leave_at_station AS "leaveAtStation", nb.enabled AS "enabled", nb.params::text AS "params" FROM node_binding nb JOIN workflow_node wn ON wn.id = nb.node_id LEFT JOIN device_point dp ON dp.id = nb.position_id LEFT JOIN resource_node rn ON rn.id = dp.point_resource_id LEFT JOIN resource_node dev ON dev.id = dp.device_resource_id LEFT JOIN device_method dm ON dm.id = nb.method_id WHERE nb.tenant_id = #{t} AND wn.workflow_id = #{workflowId} ORDER BY wn.node_key, nb.seq

SELECT w.id AS "id", w.code AS "code", w.name AS "name", w.island_id AS "islandId", (w.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS "deleted", COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM workflow_node n WHERE n.workflow_id = w.id AND n.node_type = 'task'), 0) AS "taskCount" FROM workflow w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{t} AND w.id = #{workflowId}

WITH RECURSIVE up AS ( SELECT rn.id, rn.parent_id, rn.kind::text AS kind FROM resource_node rn JOIN device_point dp ON dp.point_resource_id = rn.id WHERE dp.tenant_id = #{t} AND dp.id = #{pointId} AND rn.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT rn.id, rn.parent_id, rn.kind::text AS kind FROM resource_node rn JOIN up ON rn.id = up.parent_id WHERE rn.tenant_id = #{t} AND rn.deleted_at IS NULL ) SELECT id FROM up WHERE kind = 'island' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE experiment_template SET point_whitelist = #{whitelist}::jsonb, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE experiment_template SET workflow_ids = #{workflowIds}::bigint[], updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE experiment_template SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM experiment_template_process WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND template_id = #{templateId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO manifest_item (tenant_id, template_id, seq, role_code, material_kind, material_ref, quantity, required) VALUES (#{t}, #{templateId}, #{seq}, #{roleCode}, #{materialKind}, #{materialRef}, #{quantity}, #{required})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM manifest_item WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND template_id = #{templateId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO manifest_placement (tenant_id, run_id, manifest_item_id, position_id, status) SELECT #{t}, #{runId}, mi.id, NULL, 'unassigned' FROM manifest_item mi WHERE mi.tenant_id = #{t} AND mi.template_id = #{templateId}
mapper.select: SELECT mp.id, mp.run_id AS "runId", mp.manifest_item_id AS "manifestItemId", mp.position_id AS "positionId", mp.status, mp.reserve_same_nest AS "reserveSameNest", mp.verified_at AS "verifiedAt", mi.role_code AS "roleCode", mi.material_kind AS "materialKind", mi.material_ref AS "materialRef", mi.quantity, mi.required, COALESCE(p.lifecycle, c.lifecycle, r.lifecycle) AS "lifecycle", pr.code AS "positionCode", dr.code AS "deviceCode" FROM manifest_placement mp JOIN manifest_item mi ON mi.id = mp.manifest_item_id LEFT JOIN plate p ON mi.material_kind IN ('plate','sample','lid') AND p.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN consumable c ON mi.material_kind = 'consumable' AND c.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN reagent r ON mi.material_kind = 'reagent' AND r.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN device_point dp ON dp.id = mp.position_id LEFT JOIN resource_node pr ON pr.id = dp.point_resource_id LEFT JOIN resource_node dr ON dr.id = dp.device_resource_id WHERE mp.tenant_id = #{t} AND mp.run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY mi.seq, mp.id
mapper.update: UPDATE position_state ps SET plate_id = NULL, content_kind = NULL, content_id = NULL, occupied_by_run = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE ps.tenant_id = #{t} AND ps.resource_id IN ( SELECT dp.point_resource_id FROM manifest_placement mp JOIN manifest_item mi ON mi.id = mp.manifest_item_id JOIN device_point dp ON dp.id = mp.position_id LEFT JOIN plate p ON mi.material_kind IN ('plate','sample','lid') AND p.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN consumable c ON mi.material_kind = 'consumable' AND c.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN reagent r ON mi.material_kind = 'reagent' AND r.id = mi.material_ref WHERE mp.tenant_id = #{t} AND mp.run_id = #{runId} AND mp.status = 'unloading' AND (p.lifecycle = 'process' OR c.lifecycle = 'process' OR r.lifecycle = 'process'))

UPDATE manifest_placement mp SET status = 'unloading', updated_at = now() WHERE mp.tenant_id = #{t} AND mp.run_id = #{runId} AND mp.status = 'loaded' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM manifest_item mi LEFT JOIN plate p ON mi.material_kind IN ('plate','sample','lid') AND p.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN consumable c ON mi.material_kind = 'consumable' AND c.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN reagent r ON mi.material_kind = 'reagent' AND r.id = mi.material_ref WHERE mi.id = mp.manifest_item_id AND (p.lifecycle = 'process' OR c.lifecycle = 'process' OR r.lifecycle = 'process'))

UPDATE manifest_placement mp SET status = 'unloaded', updated_at = now() WHERE mp.tenant_id = #{t} AND mp.run_id = #{runId} AND mp.status = 'unloading' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM manifest_item mi LEFT JOIN plate p ON mi.material_kind IN ('plate','sample','lid') AND p.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN consumable c ON mi.material_kind = 'consumable' AND c.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN reagent r ON mi.material_kind = 'reagent' AND r.id = mi.material_ref WHERE mi.id = mp.manifest_item_id AND (p.lifecycle = 'process' OR c.lifecycle = 'process' OR r.lifecycle = 'process'))

UPDATE position_state ps SET plate_id = NULL, content_kind = NULL, content_id = NULL, occupied_by_run = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE ps.tenant_id = #{t} AND ps.resource_id IN ( SELECT dp.point_resource_id FROM manifest_placement mp JOIN manifest_item mi ON mi.id = mp.manifest_item_id JOIN experiment_run er ON er.id = mp.run_id JOIN device_point dp ON dp.id = mp.position_id LEFT JOIN plate p ON mi.material_kind IN ('plate','sample','lid') AND p.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN consumable c ON mi.material_kind = 'consumable' AND c.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN reagent r ON mi.material_kind = 'reagent' AND r.id = mi.material_ref WHERE mp.tenant_id = #{t} AND er.experiment_id = #{experimentId} AND mp.status = 'unloading' AND (p.lifecycle = 'process' OR c.lifecycle = 'process' OR r.lifecycle = 'process'))

UPDATE manifest_placement mp SET status = 'unloading', updated_at = now() WHERE mp.tenant_id = #{t} AND mp.status = 'loaded' AND mp.run_id IN (SELECT id FROM experiment_run WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND experiment_id = #{experimentId}) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM manifest_item mi LEFT JOIN plate p ON mi.material_kind IN ('plate','sample','lid') AND p.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN consumable c ON mi.material_kind = 'consumable' AND c.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN reagent r ON mi.material_kind = 'reagent' AND r.id = mi.material_ref WHERE mi.id = mp.manifest_item_id AND (p.lifecycle = 'process' OR c.lifecycle = 'process' OR r.lifecycle = 'process'))

UPDATE manifest_placement mp SET status = 'unloaded', updated_at = now() WHERE mp.tenant_id = #{t} AND mp.status = 'unloading' AND mp.run_id IN (SELECT id FROM experiment_run WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND experiment_id = #{experimentId}) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM manifest_item mi LEFT JOIN plate p ON mi.material_kind IN ('plate','sample','lid') AND p.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN consumable c ON mi.material_kind = 'consumable' AND c.id = mi.material_ref LEFT JOIN reagent r ON mi.material_kind = 'reagent' AND r.id = mi.material_ref WHERE mi.id = mp.manifest_item_id AND (p.lifecycle = 'process' OR c.lifecycle = 'process' OR r.lifecycle = 'process'))
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT dr.code FROM run_node rn JOIN resource_node dr ON dr.id = rn.resource_id LEFT JOIN device_state ds ON ds.resource_id = rn.resource_id WHERE rn.tenant_id = #{t} AND rn.run_id = #{runId} AND rn.resource_id IS NOT NULL AND (ds.online IS NULL OR ds.online = false) ORDER BY dr.code
SELECT count(*) FROM manifest_placement mp JOIN manifest_item mi ON mi.id = mp.manifest_item_id WHERE mp.tenant_id = #{t} AND mp.run_id = #{runId} AND mi.required = true AND mp.status <> 'verified'
